name: CoreWeave Cloud (HGX H100 / H200 / B200 / A100 nodes)
region: North America and Europe (both priced separately on the page)
notes: The most USEFUL price structure in the slice, because CoreWeave publishes all three columns - on-demand, spot, and a third 'Inference Single GPU' rate - which lets you read the market rather than guess at it. On on-demand H100 ($6.155/GPU-hr) CoreWeave sits between AWS p5 ($6.88) and the neoclouds. On SPOT H100 ($19.71/8 = $2.46/GPU-hr) it is the cheapest published H100 hour anywhere in this slice, ~64% under AWS on-demand and ~29% under even Runpod's in-stock Pod rate. The third column is the one to understand before quoting: 'Pricing based on GPUs is exclusively applicable to the CoreWeave inference platform customers' with the footnote 'contact your account executive' - so the $6.16 'Inference Single GPU' H100 number is gated to their inference platform, NOT a bare-GPU rate you can walk in and buy, and it happens to equal the on-demand per-GPU figure anyway. Also note regional asymmetry: spot is CHEAPER in Europe than North America for H100 ($19.51 vs $19.71), H200 ($20.64 vs $20.93) and A100 ($9.51 vs $9.65) - if you are EU-based, Europe is the cheaper spot market, the reverse of the usual intuition. Region-restricted deployments carry a stated 1.5x premium. The GB200 NVL72 line is the outlier worth noting: $42.00/h for 72 Blackwell GPUs is $0.58 per GPU-hour, which is not comparable to the 8-GPU node pricing and suggests rack-scale pricing is a different economic model entirely - and it is quoted for Europe too, which is unusual for a rack-scale SKU. Spot is published per region and changes continuously.
